name: PT Alfa Energi Investama Tbk
summary: PT Alfa Energi Investama Tbk, through its subsidiaries, engages in the mining, trading, and transportation of coal in Indonesia. It conducts stockpile management and crushing of coal. The company also owns a coal mine with 2,089 hectares located in Kutai Kartanegara, East Kalimantan. In addition, the company engages in investment business; and operation of power plant, as well as provides management consulting services. PT Alfa Energi Investama Tbk was founded in 2015 and is headquartered in Jakarta Selatan, Indonesia.
